people.title: Kusakam's grandfather
people.text: A lizardfolk elder of the Village, like his grandson. The cloak Kusakam wears was his.

people.title: Villager
people.text: One of the people of the Village.

people.title: City Gates guard
people.text: Keeps the gates of the City. He fought at Kusakam's side when bandits raided the gates.

people.title: Blacksmith
people.text: Forges and improves weapons and armour.

people.title: Merchant
people.text: Buys and sells goods for coins.

people.title: Priest of the Sky — oath of the Paladin
people.text: Keeper of the Paladin's oath in the City. Before her a Holy Warrior swears to the light; she can also unlearn skills for coins.

people.title: Witch — oath of the Dark Knight
people.text: Keeper of the Dark Knight's oath in the City. She can also unlearn skills for coins.

people.title: Sand dervish — oath of the Warden of Balance
people.text: Keeper of the Warden's oath in the City. He can also unlearn skills for coins.

people.title: Hunter
people.text: A hunter with a white tiger cub at her side; one of her eyes is green, the other blue.

people.title: Warrior-thaumaturge
people.text: A dragonborn barbarian with a huge spiked shield and a book; she carries the signs of fire.

people.title: Cleric of the god of contracts
people.text: A priest of the god of contracts. His smite strikes in the shape of a coin, that god's sign.
